manifest_summary.approach: Public-close-only regularized log-price AR(1), unchanged prior and risk parameters; predict decision+7 versus decision+1. Inventory-aware target rebalancing with asymmetric transaction-cost no-trade band; long-only. Buys are cash-capped at 1.35 times maximum observed close with fees/slippage; this stress is not a guaranteed future-price bound. No external data or current peer input.
manifest_summary.changes: source=sha256:b15b05daefaef9f17d2b6a767c623ad7873a24f837c4bbce81df7f541fc1c784; parent=/workspace/btc-paper/daily_491a334aba93_m1/round-0/Strategy.hs#sha256:1ce052e14754834378982fce2e85713b59baacdf61edba97310d94d22bbe49bf (v1); version=v2-inventory; effective_round=1. Hypothesis: retain the original bounded mean-reversion forecast without selecting parameters from one favorable settlement; avoid unnecessary turnover by requiring forecast edge to exceed directional execution cost. Actual edits: replace fixed initial 1000 equity and buy-only orders with supplied cash/units, marked-equity target, sell support capped at holdings, incremental buys capped by current cash under the existing 1.35-max-price stress; buy gross-log-edge threshold log(1.0005*1.001), sell threshold log(0.9995*0.999), otherwise hold. Preserve slope prior 0.90, 10 pseudo-observations, slope clip [0,0.98], six fill-to-mark variance intervals, variance penalty 3, exposure ceiling 0.95. Add zero-variance safeguard and finite-volume validation. Adopt settled round-0 coaching on fill-to-mark alignment (already implemented), truthful version provenance, cash/passive comparison and exposure confounding as interpretation constraints, not signal changes. Reject copying peer momentum parameters or treating its directional hypothesis as evidence: one settlement and the coaching packet provide no validated comparative edge. Chronological walk-forward comparison remains an unperformed research suggestion, not an adopted tested improvement. Source edits and execution/readback validation only; no backtest, parameter search, independent replay or demonstrated improvement. Single build/run, no retry or repair/resubmission.
